name: send_ipc_message
description: Send an Inter-Process Communication (IPC) message to another running process's mailbox. The target must be in the sender's own process group or be its ancestor, or be a child/sibling that is not in a restricted process group. A target in a restricted process group accepts messages only from group members or ancestors. The mailbox holds at most 64 unread messages; otherwise the send fails.

pid.description: The target Process ID (PID) to send the message to.
